title: Newmark Appointed to Lead Sale of Two Office Properties in Hong Kong
summary: Newmark announces that it has been appointed to lead the sale of two Hong Kong office properties: Enterprise Square Three in Kowloon Bay and South Seas Centre in Tsim Sha Tsui East.
